title: Practice 3: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Tom kept walking back and forth.
exercises.why: Multidirectional verbs describe: 1. General motion, referring to ability or habitual motion, without reference to direction or destination; 2. Movement in various directions; 3. Repetition of completed trips; 4. In the past tense, a single completed round trip. The basic meaning of the verbs идти, ехать, лететь is being actually on the way to some place: Мы идём в кино. Мы едем в город. Мы летим в Нью-Йорк. — right now. The verbs "ходил" and "ездил" are sometimes used instead of the verb "был". When so used, "ходил" and "ездил" may indicate a single completed trip (going to and coming from a place). This use is possible in the past tense only. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Multidirectional verbs describe: 1. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0))
